answers.label: Describe your ideal customer
answers.value:
Our ideal audience includes tabletop gamers, veterans, military families, and community members who want their hobby and participation to support a meaningful cause. Most are adults approximately 18–55, initially concentrated in Indiana and the Midwest but potentially nationwide.

They value camaraderie, welcoming communities, fair competition, and genuine support for veterans. Some veterans may be experiencing isolation, loss of purpose, PTSD, disability, or difficulty finding trustworthy resources and meaningful social connections. Tabletop gamers may want well-organized events where they feel included and can contribute to something larger than the game itself.

They want enjoyable, professionally run events; an accepting community; simple access to veteran resources; and clear ways to participate, volunteer, donate, or sponsor the mission. A secondary audience is businesses and organizations seeking a credible veteran nonprofit through which they can make a visible, measurable community impact.
